title: AssemblyPlan
description: What assemble turns into a delivery: the clips in order, the transitions between them, the audio tracks, captions, the finishing grade and the output encode. The render command builds it from a job; tests build it from synthetic clips.

version.description: Version of this document kind; always 1.

fps.description: Frames per second of every clip and of the delivery, for example 30.

width.description: Delivery width in pixels, even, for example 1920. Clips of another size are scaled and padded to it.

height.description: Delivery height in pixels, even, for example 1080.

clips.description: The clips in delivery order; at least one.

transitions.description: Transitions between consecutive clips; a pair of clips without an entry is joined by a cut. Each transition shortens the delivery by its frame count.

SourceKind.description: How a clip is stored: frames is a numbered PNG sequence named by a printf pattern, video is one encoded file.

TransitionType.description: The join between two clips, mapped to ffmpeg xfade transitions (cut has no overlap).

Codec.description: Delivery codec: h264 (libx264, the default), hevc (libx265) or prores (prores_ks 422 HQ mezzanine).

EncodePreset.description: libx264/libx265 speed preset; medium is the default.

id.description: Unique clip identifier within the plan, usually the shot id, for example "s03".

durationFrames.description: Length of the clip in frames at the plan's fps, for example 90 for three seconds at 30 fps. A video source longer than this is trimmed.

overlay.description: The clip's text plate (ADR 0008, decision 4): a numbered PNG sequence with alpha, composited over the clip's graded picture before the transitions and the grain. Null or absent when the clip has none.

kind.description: Always "frames": a text plate is a PNG sequence named by a printf pattern.

path.description: Absolute printf pattern of the text plate's frames, for example C:/vf/cache/<textKey>/frames/f%06d.png.

startNumber.description: First frame number of the pattern, for example 0.

ClipSource.description: Where a clip's pictures come from.

path.description: Absolute path: for frames, a printf pattern such as C:/vf/job1/s03/frames/f%06d.png; for video, the file itself.

startNumber.description: First frame number of a frames pattern, for example 1; ignored for video (use 0).

Transition.description: A transition that starts at the end of one clip and overlaps the start of the next.

afterClipId.description: Id of the clip the transition follows; it must not be the last clip.

frames.description: Overlap length in frames, for example 15 for half a second at 30 fps; no longer than either neighbouring clip.

NarrationLine.description: One narration recording placed on the timeline.

path.description: Absolute path of a WAV file (24 kHz or 48 kHz, mono or stereo).

startFrame.description: Frame of the delivery at which the line starts, for example 45.

Music.description: A user-supplied music track under the whole delivery.

path.description: Absolute path of the music file (WAV, FLAC, MP3 or AAC); the user is responsible for its license.

duckUnderNarration.description: True to lower the music while narration plays (ffmpeg sidechaincompress).

gainDb.description: Gain applied to the music before mixing, in decibels, for example -12.

AudioMix.description: The audio of the delivery: narration lines, optional music, loudness targets. Absent when the delivery is silent.

narration.description: Narration lines in timeline order; empty when there is none.

music.description: The music track, or null when there is none.

path.description: Absolute path of the music file (WAV, FLAC, MP3 or AAC); the user is responsible for its license.

duckUnderNarration.description: True to lower the music while narration plays (ffmpeg sidechaincompress).

gainDb.description: Gain applied to the music before mixing, in decibels, for example -12.

loudnessLufs.description: Integrated loudness target in LUFS for the two-pass loudnorm, for example -16.

truePeakDbtp.description: True-peak ceiling in dBTP, for example -1.5.

Captions.description: Captions for the delivery: an SRT file that is attached as a sidecar and, when burnIn is true, rendered into the picture.

srtPath.description: Absolute path of the SRT file.

burnIn.description: True to render the captions into the frames with the subtitles filter.

CaptionStyle.description: How burnt-in captions are set, from the look: its body family from the bundled fonts, its text colour on a scrim of its background colour, a size and a bottom margin in pixels at the delivery's height. Absent captions take ffmpeg's own style, which no look should want.

textColor.description: The caption colour as lowercase #rrggbb, the look's text colour.

scrimColor.description: The box behind each caption line as lowercase #rrggbb, the look's background colour.

scrimOpacity.description: Opacity of the scrim, 0 to 1; 0.6 is the typography system's scrim over picture.

fontSizePx.description: Size of the caption text in pixels at the delivery's height: 36 at 1080p, scaled with the height (the type scale's 24 px floor is a 1080p rule; a 270 px fixture scales to 9).

marginBottomPx.description: Distance from the bottom edge to the caption's baseline in pixels at the delivery's height, for example 72 at 1080p (inside title safe).

FontFamily.description: One of the bundled OFL font families.

FinishingGrade.description: The finishing applied to every frame before encoding (ADR 0008): a 3D LUT, a vignette and seeded grain. Absent when the clips are delivered as rendered.

cubePath.description: Absolute path of a .cube 3D LUT applied with tetrahedral interpolation in 16-bit RGB, or null for no LUT.

vignetteAmount.description: Vignette strength from 0 (none) to 1 (strong), for example 0.25.

vignetteSoftness.description: Vignette falloff from 0 (hard) to 1 (soft), for example 0.6.

grainAmount.description: Grain strength from 0 (none) to 1 (heavy), for example 0.15; applied only at assembly, never on stills.

grainSeed.description: Seed of the grain noise, for example 7; the same seed reproduces the same grain.

Output.description: The delivery file and its encode settings. Colour is always tagged BT.709, pixel format yuv420p for h264 and hevc.

path.description: Absolute path of the delivery file, for example C:/vf/out/film.mp4 (.mp4 for h264 and hevc, .mov for prores).

crf.description: Constant rate factor for h264 and hevc, 0 to 51; 16 is the delivery default. Ignored for prores.

faststart.description: True to move the MP4 index to the front (-movflags +faststart) so the file streams.
